items.title: Renault Duster and Nissan Tekton Post Their Lowest Monthly Sales in August
items.summary: Launched four months apart this year, the new Renault Duster and the Nissan Tekton which marked the two automaker’s return to the midsize SUV market in India have registered their lowest monthly wholesales in August 2026. Both midsize SUVs share the same mechanical underpinnings, identical turbo-petrol engine options, and are based on the Renault-Nissan CMF-B modular platform.

items.title: Kia Syros EV gives a new charge to Syros compact SUV sales
items.summary: Kia India had plenty of reasons to celebrate last month. August 2026, with factory dispatches of 29,042 passenger vehicles and YoY growth of 48% YoY (August 2025: 19,608 units), turned out to be its best August since the Korean carmaker entered the Indian market seven years ago in August 2019.

items.title: Mahindra SUV Sales Rise 21% in CY2026 to 541,942 Units, Intense Battle With Tata Continues
items.summary: Mahindra & Mahindra has crossed half-a-million wholesales in the first nine months of CY2026. Between January and September 2026, the Mumbai-based SUV manufacturer dispatched 541,942 SUVs including 50,835 Electric Origin SUVS (BE 6, XEV 9e and XEV 9S) to register 21% YoY growth (January-September 2025: 446,697 units).

items.title: Bajaj Auto 2W, 3W and Qute exports jump 50% in April-August to 1.26 million units
items.summary: Despite the turbulent geopolitical scenario, demand for made-in-India vehicles continues to be on the upswing. As per the latest export sales numbers released by SIAM, automobile exports across the passenger vehicle, 2-wheeler, 3-wheeler and quadricycle segments increased by 29.6% to 3.28 million units in April-August 2026.

items.title: TVS NTorq Surpasses 2.5 Million Sales, Last 500,000 Units Sold in 15 Months
items.summary: TVS Motor Co, which continues to ride a surging wave of demand for its scooters, both ICE and electrc, is benefiting from the sustained growth delivered by its second best-selling model, the NTorq. Launched on February 5, 2018, the NTorq 125 had sold 2.08 million units till end-August 2025.

items.title: Bgauss Auto sells 10,000 e-scooters in two months, will new C12 MaxR spur demand?
items.summary: India’s electric 2-wheeler growth story, which continues to scale a new high in CY2026, is being written by a clutch of legacy OEMs and a few startups. The monthly Top 10 e-2W OEM list typically has four legacy OEMs like TVS Motor, Bajaj Auto, Hero MotoCorp (Vida) and Greaves Electric Mobility with the other six comprising startups which include Ather Energy, Ola Electric, River Mobility, Bgauss Auto and Simple One.

items.title: TVS, Bajaj, Ather, Hero Vida sell a million e-scooters in 8 months of CY2026
items.summary: Combined sales of India’s top four electric two-wheeler manufacturers in the first eight months of this year have surpassed the one-million or 10 lakh-units milestone. Between January and August, market leader TVS Motor Co, Bajaj Auto, Ather Energy and Hero MotoCorp (Vida) have together sold 1.03 million units in terms of deliveries (retail sales) to customers.

items.title: Electric CV Sales Jump 155% to 23,540 Units, Tata Motors Tops but Euler Motors Shines
items.summary: In sync with the strong growth of the EV industry in India , the electric commercial vehicle (e-CV) segment is also hitting new highs this year. Not only did it register highest monthly sales in August (4,746 units, up 191% YoY) but its cumulative January-August retail sales of 23,540 units are already 6,895 units more than entire CY2025 sales (16,695 units).

items.title: Q2 surge powers electric car, SUV sales past 192,000 units in first-half FY2027
items.summary: India’s electric vehicle growth story is really charged up this year. After the first six months of FY2027, total retail sales of 18,10,163 million EVs across the e-2W, e-3W, e-passenger and e-commercial vehicle segments have risen 60% YoY (H1 FY2025: 11,34,054 units) and are already 71% of FY2026’s record 2.54 million EVs.

items.title: Tata Motors EV sales exceed 100,000 units in first 9 months of the year
items.summary: In what has already turned out to be a record-breaking calendar year on many counts for the Indian electric passenger vehicle industry, market leader Tata Motors is leading the charge and how. Between January and September 2026, a record 255,326 e-PVs have been delivered by 19 EV manufacturers to customers across the country.

items.title: Record 207,850 e-2W sales in September power H1 FY027’s 1.12 million units
items.summary: With the sixth month of the current fiscal and a record one at that, it’s amply clear that India’s electric 2-wheeler industry is on a roll and how. While January-September 2026 retail sales have already crossed 1.61 million units, e-2W customer deliveries in the April-September period jumped 76% to 1.12 million units (H1 FY2026: 640,149 units).

items.title: Tessolve Semiconductor Raises $75 Million from Vector Line Capital
items.summary: Tessolve Semiconductor, a Hero Electronix company, has secured a $75 million investment from Vector Line Capital, a US-based firm that invests exclusively in semiconductors and the semiconductor supply chain.
